report.interpretation: Six independent deployment seeds; bootstrap intervals are descriptive. Replicas, histories, futures and nested horizons are not additional independent seeds.

config.scope: Observer-only action/horizon diagnostic with known task IDs, groups and boundaries. Same-prefix restored learner and simulator, explicit future stochastic reseeding, continued local PPO, frozen parent after one generic retention operation. No unchosen outcome is supplied to a deployed selector; no learned-policy improvement or global oracle bound is claimed.
config.seed_selection: First mapping-only unused seeds in 25101..25300 satisfying A/even=2,A/odd=1,B/even=1,B/odd=2; three old-family A, three B, three even and three odd; no rewards examined.
